astar_escalation: stop node escalation at first valid solution; if time rather than nodes limits the last case, test only that node limit at 60s
optional_sampling_trigger: All S1 settings in A+B produce zero valid_by_budget paths
profiling: S3 seed0, n_max=10: unobserved, observed, cProfile; fixed work, not performance ranking
holdout_selection: choose only among A/B single-factor settings; highest dev valid_by_budget count across S1/S2/S3; retain baseline unless strictly better; ties use lower capacity then side length closest to5
event_policy: S1 seed0 only, candidate insertion/eviction/expansion/open-at-stop; cap20000 rows with explicit dropped counter
reference_reuse: reuse only identical stage3 jobs; never reuse stage2 rows as stage3 measurements
